description: This file contains implementation of backend APIs for the COSA Data Model related to harvester functionality, including creation, initialization, and removal of harvester objects.

methods.name: CosaHarvesterCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new harvester object by allocating memory and returning its handle.

methods.name: CosaHarvesterInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the harvester object by calling the DML initialization function.

methods.name: CosaHarvesterRemove
methods.description: Removes the harvester object by freeing its allocated memory.
